items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: So you had access to them that you might not have under other circumstances.

Yeah, that‟s right too. It was great to see, and I can see myself and knowing… hearing Bill Johnson, this great bass player that was so strong. I didn‟t see Pops Foster. You see, if you knew all those people, they had two routes, they followed the ocean or the water or people followed the river of New Orleans right up the Mississippi River, came on up to St Louis and then into Chicago. The other group came from New Orleans and followed the sea and went right on to San Francisco. A great group of New Orleans…

Right, yeah. I met him… I had met him in New York but I really got to know him fairly well in these last years when he was playing with Earl Hines and he was doing some things out in San Francisco. He was a wonderful old man.
